messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected: az1a resolver latency spike > 400ms across controlplane -> impact: p95/p99 token lat for hosted inference increased, some clients seeing 502s. auto-pager triggered. @sre-oncall
alex: ack, I'm on it. grabbing metrics now. seen any customer errors in SLO dashboards? :eyes:
maria: adding runtime sigs — I'm seeing a flurry of KV cache TTL reloads and `kvcache_miss` counts spiking around 14:04:10 UTC. models hitting regen path repeatedly.
jamie: infra side: DNS resolver latency for az1a jumped, connect backlog growing on resolver pool instances. looks like resolver threads saturated, TCP accept queue at 80% capacity.
alex: can we confirm scope? single AZ? cross AZ? any egress issues? if single AZ resolver, we should consider steering traffic to regional resolvers.
jamie: confirmed single-AZ impact. other AZs OK. route53-resolver health checks show increased RTT only for az1a.
cs_liaison: customer impact: support queue has ~12 tickets mentioning slow responses/timeout. majority are mid-tier customers using hosted inference. estimated affected requests ~3-5% of global traffic, concentrated in az1a.
ops_lead: customer-visible SLO alert firing. prepare brief for any escalations. alex, what's immediate mitigations?
alex: steps I'm doing now: 1) enable fallback routing to regional resolver pool for az1a hosts (soft steer), 2) enable model fallback to smaller variant for affected routes to reduce KV pressure, 3) temporarily increase retry jitter to avoid synchronized retries. executing in that order.
maria: adding that we should throttle regen frequency for KV cache — put a short cooldown (30s) between regen attempts to avoid stampede.
jamie: initiating resolver pool diversion: `infractl steer-resolver --from az1a --to eu1a --pct 40` — rolling now. watching tcp_accept backlog and resolver latency.
deploy-bot: deploy started: resolver-steer v1.2 -> 10% -> 40% rollout in progress
alex: watching p99 token latency. initial 40% steer shows tail latency dropping in 60s for those requests. overall error rate down ~30%.
maria: applied KV regen cooldown patch to runtime: `kvcache.regen_cooldown=30s` via hot-config; reload pushed to 6k hosts in az1a. will monitor mem / OOM risk.
jamie: resolver accept queue now 32% and median resolver RTT down to ~55ms for steered hosts. still some stuck sockets; working with cloud team to cycle 2 resolver VMs with drained connections.
kevin: taking over oncall for the next 40m. alex handing off context: steer at 40%, regen cooldown enabled, model fallback running for route group `hosted-gen-v1`.
alex: handing off. notes: customer impact ~3-5%, major mitigations applied, watch for rollback conditions in case of regression: increased 5xx, model-quality alerts, or KV error rate rising.
cs_liaison: prepping customer note: short update to affected tenants describing degraded latency, mitigation steps, and ETA for full recovery. will post to status page after ops_lead review.
ops_lead: agreed. cs_liaison, draft and ping me for approval. also start incident timeline for postmortem.
kevin: I'll keep ramping steer to 60% if metrics continue improving. also coordinating with cloud support to check for underlying resolver process saturation root cause.
jamie: cloud support reports kernel tcp backlog bug correlated with specific nic firmware on resolver instances. patch rolling to resolver fleet scheduled in 18m. will keep steering until patch completes.
alex: adding temporary safeguard: set per-host resolver thread limit to reduce queue depth; pushing config change now.
kevin: noted. if any regression or rollback triggers, notify immediately and we'll reconvene.
incident-bot: INCIDENT update: mitigations applied, partial relief observed. P95 token latency improved from 1.8s -> 0.9s for steered traffic. continue monitoring.
cs_liaison: status page draft ready, posting in 5 once ops_lead approves. customer support template prepared.
ops_lead: approved. cs_liaison, post and tag #status and affected customers list.
kevin: continuing watch. next update in 15 or on major change.
deploy-bot: resolver-firmware-patch scheduled -> maintenance window at +18m -> rolling patch across az1a resolver hosts.
alex: thanks team. initial RCA pointers: resolver thread saturation -> TCP backlog -> KV cache regen stampede -> model fallback oscillation risk. we'll capture full timeline in postmortem.
kevin: handoff complete, I'm the current owner. everyone add any lingering notes here for the timeline. :white_check_mark:
